svg.title: dooc hosting options
svg.desc: Your native files and dooc.yaml form one document. Run the editor or viewer locally with Node, self-host a Node workspace on your server, or host a static app whose workspace runs in the browser. Publish a separate HTML snapshot to read, share, or host.
